eod.conclusion: Indian equities extended gains for a third straight session, though off intraday highs, as reduced volatility supported bullish sentiment. Financial and IT stocks showed divergent trends while the rupee strengthened. Global cues remained positive with UK markets rising on economic recovery signs. The LIC offering saw robust retail interest, indicating continued investor confidence in large-cap offerings despite selective profit-taking during the session.
